text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Traaaiiineeer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I just ran in my debut race! I
persevered until the
very end!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm going to continue working
hard in
order to become the best runner
ever. And then,
the G1 races...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ack! I mean…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to gradually get used to
regular races,
all so I can become my
ideal princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her debut race, Kawakami Princess
wasn't
anywhere near as tense as she was
during her
previous scrimmages.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she continues honing her mind and
body, it'll no
doubt result in immensely
improved running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Definitely!
choice_data_list: 最高のプリンセスになろう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Kawakami Princess and I are
leaving
Hanshin Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Kawakami Princess! Could I
have a
moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I'm on my way home! So I
can't go
out for tea with you right now.
Wouldn't you
agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Is that so?! Very well, then—ask
away!
choice_data_list: これは取材の申し込みだよ

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you very much. Your running
was
tremendous, and you have a
charming
personality, too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Well, don't stop the
compliments there!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'll get straight to the point then.
What's
the next big race you've set your
sights on? I'm
guessing it'll be the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, or
perhaps the
Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?
choice_data_list: 長居できませんので、ご質問からどうぞ

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I have none!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: O-oh, I see... And why would that be?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My objective this year is to get used to
racing!
And when the time comes, I'll
burst out of
nowhere and blow everyone
away!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see. By the way, can you tell me exactly when this time will come?
choice_data_list: ……なので目標レースは絞りません

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Well, of course, that will
be...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...When will that be, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, now I'm all pumped! Make sure
you keep
those eyes peeled and locked
on my progress,
Mr. Reporter!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You really are an interesting
pair. Thank
you for your responses!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some days later, in my office...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Up-and-Coming Umamusume:
Kawakami
Princess! She promises she'll
blow away the
competition, yet her
goals remain secret."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-woooow! My comments were
published in the
newspaper!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not on the front page, nor is it a
feature
article—just a few lines tucked
away in the corner.
But it's more than
enough to get Kawakami
Princess
hopping with happy excitement.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going to build up more and
more
racing experience and become a
true princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, I need to enter her in plenty of
races
and build up her fan base, until
she has enough
experience to run any
race without letting the
tension get to
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll help her to improve both her mind
and body,
one step at a time.
